topics.definition: IPC enables processes to exchange data and coordinate execution.
topics.syntax: Pipes, Message Queues, Shared Memory, Sockets
tips: Choose the IPC mechanism based on performance and requirements.

topics.definition: A pipe is a communication channel that transfers data between related processes.
tips: Anonymous pipes are commonly used between parent and child processes.

topics.definition: Message queues allow processes to exchange messages asynchronously.
tips: Processes do not need to execute simultaneously.

topics.definition: Shared memory allows multiple processes to access the same memory region.
tips: Requires synchronization mechanisms such as semaphores.

topics.definition: Sockets enable communication between processes over a network.
topics.example: Web browser communicating with a web server

topics.definition: Operating system security protects resources from unauthorized access.
tips: Keep the OS updated and use strong passwords.

topics.definition: Virtualization allows multiple virtual machines to run on one physical computer.
Containers package applications with their dependencies in isolated environments.
tips: Containers are lightweight compared to virtual machines.

topics.definition: Maintain a secure, stable and efficient operating system through updates, backups and monitoring.
